stories.title: Raad van State wijst bezwaren af: Defensie mag radarstation in Herwijnen bouwen

en.title: Council of State rejects objections: Defense may build radar station in Herwijnen
en.summary: The Netherlands' highest administrative court has dismissed objections from residents and the West Betuwe municipality against a military radar station planned for the village of Herwijnen. The court found the government adequately justified its choice of location.

stories.title: Australische illustrator Terry Denton (De waanzinnige boomhut) overleden

en.title: Australian illustrator Terry Denton (The Crazy Tree House) deceased
en.summary: Australian illustrator Terry Denton has died at age 76. Denton was known worldwide for his illustrations in The Crazy Tree House book series, created with writer Andy Griffiths, and for his own illustrated works.

stories.title: Singapore geeft hoge boetes voor voeten op stoelen en luide muziek in de bus

en.title: Singapore issues high fines for feet on seats and loud music on buses
en.summary: Singapore is implementing fines of 500 Singapore dollars for bus passengers who play loud music, place their feet on seats, litter, or eat and drink on public transport.

stories.title: Schrijver Sjoerd Kuyper was er oprecht van overtuigd dat kinderen schoonheid verdienen

en.title: Writer Sjoerd Kuyper genuinely believed children deserve beauty
en.summary: Dutch children's author Sjoerd Kuyper, who died at age 74, was known for taking children seriously by centering the childlike perspective in his works, including his acclaimed Robin series.

stories.title: Kinderboekenschrijver Sjoerd Kuyper, bekend van Het zakmes, overleden

en.title: Children's book author Sjoerd Kuyper, known for The Pocketknife, has died
en.summary: Dutch author Sjoerd Kuyper died at age 74 after a brief illness. He was a prolific writer for over fifty years, primarily known for children's books including the Robin series and other works that won multiple literary awards.

stories.title: Het zakmes-schrijver Sjoerd Kuyper op 74-jarige leeftijd overleden

en.title: The Pocketknife author Sjoerd Kuyper died at age 74
en.summary: Sjoerd Kuyper, author of The Pocketknife book and film, died at age 74 following a brief illness. He was widely recognized for his children's books, which earned him numerous prizes.

stories.title: Nederland doet volgend jaar toch mee met Eurovisie Songfestival, NPO op zoek naar kandidaat

en.title: Netherlands will participate in next year's Eurovision Song Contest after all, NPO seeks candidate
en.summary: The Netherlands will compete in the Eurovision Song Contest in Bulgaria despite the broadcasting organization AvroTros withdrawing participation last month. The public broadcaster is now searching for a representative.

stories.title: Nederland doet weer mee aan Songfestival: NOS verzorgt uitzending, ‘onafhankelijk team’ inzending

en.title: Netherlands participates in Song Festival again: NOS handles broadcast, 'independent team' handles submission
en.summary: The Netherlands will participate in the Eurovision Song Contest, with NOS handling the broadcast and an independent team managing the submission.

stories.title: Nederland doet weer mee aan Songfestival, NPO trekt selectie naar zich toe

en.title: Netherlands participates in Song Festival again, NPO takes over selection
en.summary: The Netherlands will return to the Eurovision Song Festival after a year's absence, with the Dutch public broadcaster NPO now coordinating the national entry as a joint project and overseeing artist selection and support.

stories.title: ‘De waanzinnige boomhut’-illustrator liet zijn tekeningen er expres onhandig uitzien

en.title: Illustrator of 'The Ridiculous Treehouse' deliberately made drawings look clumsy
en.summary: The illustrator of 'The Ridiculous Treehouse' intentionally created drawings with an awkward appearance.

stories.title: Singapore wil af van luide muziek uit telefoons in de bus en dreigt met hoge boetes

en.title: Singapore wants to eliminate loud music from phones on buses and threatens high fines
en.summary: Singapore introduced fines of approximately 350 euros for bus passengers playing loud music or making loud speakerphone calls, as part of broader enforcement against disruptive behavior including eating, leaving trash, and putting feet on seats.

stories.title: Nederland doet toch mee aan Eurovisie Songfestival

en.title: Netherlands to participate in Eurovision Song Festival after all
en.summary: The Netherlands will compete in next year's Eurovision Song Festival, ending uncertainty about participation following AVROTROS's earlier decision to boycott the event.
